definitions: Days are calendar days in Maldives time (UTC+5).

Visitors are counted per browser with a random id kept in that browser. It isn't a cookie and isn't linked to an account. No individual visits, search words or addresses are stored — only daily totals.
Administrators' own browsing isn't counted, and farmers' views and clicks on their own listings aren't either.
Counting started when this version of analytics went live; earlier activity isn't included.
Invoice and payment figures are what users recorded. Only administrator-verified payments have been checked against evidence.
farmerDefinitions: Days are calendar days in Maldives time (UTC+5).
A visitor opening the same listing or your farm page several times in a day counts once. Your own visits aren't counted.
Contact clicks mean a buyer's phone or chat app was opened, not that they reached you or bought anything.
Enquiries are counted from the enquiries buyers actually sent.
